verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a per-endpoint API reference generated from its OpenAPI 3.1 specification, covering agents, runs, browser sessions and credentials. The spec is served at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json, so the reference layer is real. Nothing in the evidence says the reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. The probe 404s on skyvern.com paths do not contradict the spec served at api.skyvern.com. Missing for 10: documented interactive playground or 'try it' console, runnable code examples per endpoint, independent or hands-on confirmation of the reference experience.
